create_qre_solver: create a QRE solver instance with configurable temperature, learning rates, and variance reduction
run_mirror_descent_step: run entropic mirror descent step to update distribution and auxiliary variables
run_euc_descent_step: run projected gradient descent step with Euclidean projection onto the simplex
compute_qre_gradients: compute exploitability gradients for distribution and auxiliary variables using stochastic sampling
compute_qre_exploitability: compute Shannon entropy regularized exploitability of the current policy distribution
